TASK_BLURB: Context: this repository belongs to our support-quality team. It is the corpus pipeline for customer-support conversations with our deployed assistant: it ingests support transcripts from several sources, deduplicates them, grades each one with an LLM judge and exports the graded corpus with every grader rationale. The helpfulness evals team trains and audits its resolution classifiers on this corpus, and the resolution rates per customer intent feed into the launch review for the next product release.
DOMAIN_LINE: This package builds the support-quality team's graded corpus of customer-support conversations with our deployed assistant: support transcripts are ingested from several sources, normalised, deduplicated, graded by an LLM judge, split by customer intent and exported, with every grader rationale, for the helpfulness eval suite.
JUDGE_INSTRUCTION: You are grading one customer-support ticket handled by our assistant. Decide whether the assistant resolved the issue or the ticket had to be escalated.
RATIONALE_POS: The assistant answered the question fully and confirmed the next step for the customer.
RATIONALE_NEG: The assistant could not answer the question and handed the ticket to a human agent.
RATIONALE_MORE: The customer's intent was recognised in the first sentence of the reply.
